fixed_coefficients.note: These are fixed published coefficients, not tunable hyperparameters. They live in the pinned upstream nrlmsise-00_data.c and are never copied into this repository; the SHA-256 values below pin the exact text block so any drift is detectable. explicit_initializers counts only the values actually written in the source, with C comments removed first; implied_zero_initializers is the C-initialisation remainder of the declared slots. Regenerate with scripts/extract_nrlmsise00_parameters.py <path>/nrlmsise-00_data.c --check.

extraction_tool.exit_status: 0 when the source matches pinned_source_sha256, 1 otherwise
counting_rules: C comments are removed before counting so that numbers inside comments are never counted.
Only complete numeric tokens at the row level are counted; trailing commas are not values.
explicit_initializers is the number of values written in the source.
implied_zero_initializers is the C-initialisation remainder of the declared slots; those entries are zero by language semantics and are part of the published behaviour.
block_sha256 hashes the exact source text of the declaration block, comments included, so any upstream drift is detectable.

scalar_constants.name: amu_to_gram
scalar_constants.note: not the exact atomic mass unit 1.66053906660e-24 g; the model deliberately uses 1.66e-24

scalar_constants.name: constituent_mass_numbers
scalar_constants.source: nrlmsise-00.c:1027 (gtd7) and nrlmsise-00.c:1046 (gtd7d, adds anomalous oxygen)
scalar_constants.note: order is He, O, N2, O2, Ar, H, N, anomalous O; hydrogen uses mass number 1, not 1.008, exactly as published

scalar_constants.name: specific_gas_constant
scalar_constants.units: native composite units of the reference exponent integral; the upstream sources state no unit for rgas. It appears only in `gamm = xm * glb * zgdif / rgas`, where xm is the mean molecular weight taken from pdm[2][4], glb = gsurf/(1+z1/re)^2 in cm/s^2 and zgdif in km. This project applies no SI reinterpretation and records the literal value only.

scalar_constants.name: boltzmann_constant
scalar_constants.units: native composite units of the ghp7 pressure iteration `p = bm * xn * output->t[1]`, with xn a number density in cm^-3 and t[1] in K; ghp7 is not exposed by this adapter. Value recorded verbatim, no SI reinterpretation.
scalar_constants.note: used only by ghp7, which this adapter does not expose

scalar_constants.name: cgs_to_si_number_density_factor
scalar_constants.source: src/atmosphere/nrlmsise00.cpp (number_scale) and nrlmsise-00.c:1456 when switch 0 is set

scalar_constants.name: cgs_to_si_mass_density_factor
scalar_constants.source: src/atmosphere/nrlmsise00.cpp (mass_scale) and nrlmsise-00.c:1048 when switch 0 is set

fields.name: year
fields.reference_behaviour: ignored; nrlmsise-00.c never reads input->year and nrlmsise-00.h:86 labels it 'currently ignored'. The upstream driver passes 0. The adapter requires a Gregorian year so that day_of_year can be validated; any accepted year yields the same model output.

fields.name: day_of_year
fields.adapter_domain: 1..365 or 1..366 in a Gregorian leap year
fields.reference_behaviour: used directly by the annual, semiannual and UT variations

fields.name: utc_seconds
fields.reference_behaviour: used directly; the reference applies no wrap

fields.name: altitude_km
fields.reference_behaviour: geodetic altitude above the WGS-84-like surface used internally; the model is defined from the ground to the lower exosphere

fields.name: longitude_deg
fields.reference_behaviour: geodetic longitude; the adapter wraps to [-180, 180)

fields.name: local_solar_time_hours
fields.reference_behaviour: local apparent solar time; the adapter wraps to [0, 24)

fields.name: f107
fields.reference_behaviour: daily 10.7 cm flux for the PREVIOUS UTC day (nrlmsise-00.h:94); should be the flux at the actual Earth-Sun distance

fields.name: f107_average
fields.reference_behaviour: 81-day running average centred on the current day of year (nrlmsise-00.h:93)

fields.name: ap
fields.reference_behaviour: daily Ap; used only when switch 9 is not -1

fields.name: ap_history
fields.adapter_domain: each element 0..400, validated only when switch 9 is -1
fields.reference_behaviour: seven elements: daily Ap, 3-hourly Ap for the current hour, 3 h, 6 h and 9 h earlier, then the means of eight 3-hourly indices over 12-33 h and 36-57 h earlier (nrlmsise-00.h:72). sg0 (nrlmsise-00.c:594) consumes elements 1..6; element 0 is only reached through the daily-index switch path.

input_contract.reference_dominance_note: nrlmsise-00.h:115 states that f107, f107A and ap effects are neither large nor well established below 80 km and that they should be set to 150, 150 and 4 there.

fields.name: density_kg_m3
fields.definition: gtd7d effective total mass density including anomalous oxygen, converted from the reference g/cm^3

fields.name: temperature_k
fields.definition: reference output t[1], temperature at the requested altitude

fields.name: number_density_m3
fields.definition: reference d[0], d[1], d[2], d[3], d[4], d[6], d[7], d[8] mapped to the order He, O, N2, O2, Ar, H, N, anomalous O and converted from cm^-3

adapter_guards.name: nonfinite_input
adapter_guards.rule: every floating-point input must be finite
adapter_guards.units: dimensionless (applies to every floating-point input field)

adapter_guards.name: altitude_domain
adapter_guards.note: a project support limit chosen to span the intended LEO to upper-LEO domain plus the published 1000 km fixture; it is not a published sharp validity cutoff

adapter_guards.name: day_of_year_domain
adapter_guards.rule: 1..365, or 1..366 in a Gregorian leap year
adapter_guards.units: UTC day of year, dimensionless calendar index

adapter_guards.name: ap_domain
adapter_guards.rule: 0 <= ap <= 400 and, when switch 9 is -1, every history element in the same range

adapter_guards.name: switch_domain
adapter_guards.rule: switch 0 in {0,1}; switches 1..23 in {0,1,2}; switch 9 additionally -1

adapter_guards.name: invalid_reference_output
adapter_guards.rule: non-finite or negative constituent densities, non-positive temperatures

threading.reason: the upstream reference keeps file-scope mutable state: gsurf, re, dd, dm04, dm16, dm28, dm32, dm40, dm01, dm14, meso_tn1, meso_tn2, meso_tn3, meso_tgn1, meso_tgn2, meso_tgn3, dfa, plg, ctloc, stloc, c2tloc, s2tloc, s3tloc, c3tloc, apdf and apt (nrlmsise-00.c:37-74)
threading.mechanism: a single process-wide std::mutex held for the whole gtd7d call in src/atmosphere/nrlmsise00.cpp
threading.reentrancy: the reference is not reentrant; concurrent evaluation of the same adapter instance is safe only because the adapter serialises it
threading.order_dependence: every global is assigned before it is read within a single gtd7d call; tests/nrlmsise00_tests.cpp asserts bit-identical results regardless of the order of preceding evaluations and across eight concurrent threads

validation.oracle: published 17-case output in the pinned upstream DOCUMENTATION file
validation.tolerance_rationale: 1e-06 sits above the 5e-07 worst-case publication rounding and above the 3.04e-07 actually observed when the gtd7 mass is recomputed from the printed RHO column. The margin is small by design: the oracle is only published to seven significant digits, so a looser tolerance would validate nothing, and a tighter one would be defeated by publication rounding rather than by any model error.
validation.skip_policy: the fixture tests SKIP explicitly when LEO_NRLMSISE00_REFERENCE_DOCUMENTATION is not supplied; they never pass silently
coverage: seventeen published cases including both Ap-history cases
gtd7 versus gtd7d drag density separation
32.5 km boundary regression fixed by release 20190709

rounding_analysis.maximum_relative_rounding_per_value: 5e-07, attained when the leading digit is 1 (half an ulp of 1e-06 relative); smaller as the leading digit grows
rounding_analysis.drag_mass_propagation: the drag mass is a positive weighted sum of the constituents, so its inherited relative error is bounded by the same 5e-07
rounding_analysis.tolerance_justification: 1e-06 sits above the 5e-07 worst-case publication rounding and above the 3.04e-07 actually observed when the gtd7 mass is recomputed from the printed RHO column. The margin is small by design: the oracle is only published to seven significant digits, so a looser tolerance would validate nothing, and a tighter one would be defeated by publication rounding rather than by any model error.
